MORE:
Inland Printers Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the unaudited financial results on standalone basis for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026.
In terms of the Code of Conduct of the Company for Regulating, Monitoring and Reporting of Trading by Designated Persons and Immediate Relatives of Designated persons ("the Code"), the Trading Window for transactions in the equity shares of the Company has been already closed from October 1, 2026 till 48 hours after the declaration of the financial results for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026
